scope: Raw IPv6 UDP reachability only; not WebRTC, media, control, stability, or latency acceptance
guards: The selected Windows source and Orin source were global IPv6 addresses.
The Orin UDP socket was bound to its cellular interface and its route to the Windows peer was checked.
Each received datagram was checked for the expected peer address, port and per-run nonce.
CAN was observed DOWN before and after the probe.
limitations: The endpoints were started separately, so send and receive counts cannot establish packet loss.
FrameForge CPU work was observed on Orin before this test and was not paused; its load was not measured continuously.
No camera, WebRTC negotiation, DataChannel, input lease, mock vehicle control, clock threshold, latency or 30-minute behavior was tested.
